title: P1 world interact request payload
description: Payload of POST /p1/world/interact. The envelope keeps the shared Envelope shape; only INTERACTABLE and GATHER_NODE entities can be targeted.

targetId.description: A canonical ENT_ entity, or one of the six alpha overlay ids published by DEC-ALPHA-INTERACT-IDS-20261105. The ALPHA_ prefix itself is not accepted: an id outside the exact list (including the training hazard ALPHA_WAVE_BM_TRAINING) is refused as invalid_payload.
